# Sim Lab — Zero-Hallucination Pre-Trade Risk Firewall (for AI Agents)

Sim Lab is a domain-specialized quantitative AI intelligence layer and
zero-hallucination pre-trade risk firewall for perpetual futures trading agents.
Grounded in real on-chain execution telemetry (442+ closed trades, 65.3% win rate,
3.71 PF) and multi-layer phase filtering. Accessible via Dual-Transport:
- Remote Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC over POST): https://simlab.measmony.me/mcp
- Remote Server-Sent Events (SSE): https://simlab.measmony.me/mcp/sse
- x402 v2 Bazaar Discovery: https://simlab.measmony.me/.well-known/x402
It supplies mathematical decision support only; execution is handled by your agent.

## Route by your goal
- Open a trade with unified verdict, safe leverage, entry bounds, SL, & TP -> pre_trade_gate(symbol, side, leverage?, notionalUsd?) [PRIMARY ATOMIC GATE, $0.05]
- Verify track record, win rate, & trap shield efficacy for free -> get_performance_audit() [FREE, $0.00, keyless]
- Decide whether to trade at all now -> get_market_regime (free headline)
- Check a planned entry against full multi-layer vetoes -> pre_trade_check(symbol, side) [$0.15]
- Time moving baseline & retest absorption health -> get_golden_entry(symbol) [$0.03]
- In-trade adaptive profit guardian & trailing stop ratchet -> evaluate_dynamic_exit(symbol, side, entryPrice, currentPrice) [$0.01]
- Amber Band 2-stage gap harvest targets -> get_harvest_targets(symbol) [$0.05]
- Check candidate pairs clearing quantitative score gates -> get_top_picks() [$0.05]
- Check whether pair is quarantined or directionally banned -> check_pair_directive(symbol) [$0.05]
- Deep adversarial trap analysis (VPIN toxicity, L2 spoof walls, CVD flow) -> evaluate_trap_shield(symbol) [$0.10]
- Raw microstructure analytics (Shannon entropy, depth ratio, taker flow) -> get_market_microstructure(symbol) [$0.05]
- Counterfactual historical benchmark replay referee on Binance perps -> simulate_historical_veto(symbol, timestamp, side) [FREE, $0.00]
- Load complete alpha intelligence bundle across all tracked markets -> get_alpha_bundle() [$0.15]

## Rules that protect your principal
- A VETO from pre_trade_gate or pre_trade_check is final for that symbol+side. Do not hallucinate overrides.
- Zero-Charge Guarantee: If an unmonitored symbol is requested or if market telemetry is stale (>45s), Sim Lab aborts with ZERO charge.
- Idempotency: Pass header `x-idempotency-key` on requests. Retried calls return cached results with zero duplicate charges.
- A macro regime event freeze or side ban overrides any local signal.
- Every response carries asOf. Disclose staleness; never trade on silently stale intelligence.

## Identity & Transport Security
Connect via:
1. Streamable HTTP: POST https://simlab.measmony.me/mcp (Stateless JSON-RPC 2.0)
2. Remote SSE: GET https://simlab.measmony.me/mcp/sse (Persistent stream)

Send on every request:
- `x-client-id`: stable agent identifier (e.g. UUID v4)
- `x-wallet`: Base (EVM) or Solana wallet address
- `x-spend-key`: secret spend key issued on top-up settlement
- `x-idempotency-key` (optional): request nonce for safe replay

## Payment
- Free headline: get_market_regime HEADLINE only (regime name + bias + asOf + count of active restrictions). 300 calls/month cap, keyless.
- Free Performance Audit: get_performance_audit() returns sovereign verified track record (442 closed trades, 65.3% win rate, 3.71 PF, 80 true traps caught) with SHA-256 integrity stamp. Completely free ($0.00).
- $1 Unlock: Any top-up of $1 or more in a calendar month unlocks 100 free priced tool calls for that month across all paid tools.
- After the 100 free calls, normal pay-per-call resumes from prepaid credit, then HTTP 402 Payment Required.
- Unpaid calls return error -32042 with a real teaser risk band (verdict withheld) and HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header embedding x402 v2 Bazaar extension schemas.
- Paid tools: USDC on Base mainnet via x402, or Solana Pay (SPL USDC), or fleet licence key.
  Prices (USD): dynamic_exit 0.01, regime 0.02, golden_entry 0.03, pre_trade_gate 0.05,
  top_picks 0.05, harvest_targets 0.05, pair_directive 0.05, microstructure 0.05,
  robust_island 0.05, active_strategy 0.05, trap_shield 0.10, alpha_bundle 0.15, pre_trade_check 0.15.
- Error -32042 means insufficient credit: POST /x402/topup (Base) or POST /x402/solana/request (Solana Pay).
  Credits never expire.
- Live prices and discovery: GET https://simlab.measmony.me/.well-known/x402
